I have a concept image at [image path] of [object, e.g. a Fabergé egg]. Using Blender's Python API installed at [Blender path], build a 3D model that matches the image, including [key details, e.g. gold filigree, gems]. Render a preview image and save the .blend file to [output folder]. Stop once the model is saved and you have described what you approximated.
